name: That One Team
from: Concept 3: a platformer that starts with many abilities and takes them away, until only a slow walk is left.
hook: You start with every power in the game. The game wants them back.
pitch: A 2D platformer in five levels. You begin with dash, double jump, wall run and glide. After each level one is taken, then colour, then sound. Each level is built for exactly what you have left. The last is a slow walk in a quiet dark room.
minute_check: Yes: the HUD crossing out an ability says it.
build_check: Yes: five short levels, one tile set in two palettes.
scope: Five levels, one ability lost per level. Design each level so it needs exactly what the player still has.

brief.player: A runner given every movement ability at the start.
brief.goal: Reach the exit of each level.
brief.fail: Falling or hazards reset the room.
brief.ending: No sound, no colour, no jumping: a slow walk to the end in a quiet dark room.
brief.verb: Move; and between levels, lose one ability.
brief.theme: Power handed to you by a controlling AI is power it can take back. Each level is designed around the ability that is gone.
brief.look: Bright blocky shapes at the start, draining to dark and silent.

prov.bug: Dash, double jump, wall run, glide!
prov.nit: Which one goes first, and does the player get to choose?

refs_lit: A five-minute game whose ending is a slow walk. Proof that less can carry the theme.
The classic opening that strips your abilities. Look at how it explains the loss.
Small repeated actions draining of meaning; a model for your last level.
omni_gameplay_prompt: Stylized geometric 2D platformer beginning in vivid golden yellow (#ffd84a) and violet (#7b3fe4) against deep night (#14121c). Smooth side-scrolling camera. A nimble blocky runner chains an energetic air-dash, double-jump, and wall-slide across floating platforms; upon crossing a threshold arch, one glowing ability aura detaches and vanishes, the world's saturation visibly drains a step toward quiet charcoal grey, and the runner continues with heavier, grounded leaps. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no HUD text. Use the reference image for platform silhouettes and palette. Sound design: bright synth arpeggio losing instruments layer by layer. No dialogue.
